name: io.github.gistrec/mcp-mysql-client
title: MySQL MCP
description: MCP server for one MySQL database: schema, read-only queries and guarded writes.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_USER
environmentVariables.description: MySQL user. Use one with the least privileges the task needs, never root.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_PASS
environmentVariables.description: Password for that user. Treat it as a secret; MYSQL_PASS_FILE reads it from a file instead.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_DB
environmentVariables.description: The one database this server is bound to. No tool can leave it.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_SSL
environmentVariables.description: Require a TLS connection to the server.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_SSL_CA
environmentVariables.description: Path to the CA bundle verifying the server certificate; implies MYSQL_SSL.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_INSERT_OPERATION
environmentVariables.description: Allow INSERT statements through the execute tool.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_UPDATE_OPERATION
environmentVariables.description: Allow UPDATE statements through the execute tool.

environmentVariables.name: ALLOW_DELETE_OPERATION
environmentVariables.description: Allow DELETE statements through the execute tool.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_MAX_ROWS
environmentVariables.description: Row cap for one read; the result is marked truncated when it is hit.

environmentVariables.name: MYSQL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Statement timeout in milliseconds; the connection is dropped on expiry.
